ambiguity.detail: The flash-forward line about being dead to the family adds high-stakes mystery to the ongoing wedding.

verdict.hook_line: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...
verdict.viewer_takeaway: Despite her family's disownment, the bride defiantly marries the mysterious stranger at the altar.
verdict.why_it_works: A satisfying wedding ceremony payoff combined with a high-stakes flash-forward hook provides maximum emotional payoff.
